cross_disciplinary_pairing.description: Offline bilingual subnetting tutor combining math reasoning (powers of 2, CIDR) with interactive networking education for schools without reliable internet.

test_prompts.prompt: A school network uses 192.168.5.0/24 and needs at least 25 usable hosts per subnet. Using powers of 2, find the subnet mask, number of subnets, and block size. Show each step.
Explain in Arabic why borrowing 3 host bits from a /24 creates 8 subnets. Use the finger-counting method and show the math.
